The combined codex-hongguo distribution is conveyed under GPL-3.0-only (COPYING).

Other dependencies retain their own notices and licenses in licenses/.
The matching codex-hongguo source and build scripts are supplied in
licenses/codex-hongguo-source.zip. Extract it, install Node.js and Go, run
`npm ci --ignore-scripts`, then `npm run build`. `npm run package` rebuilds
the distribution. The FFmpeg component has its separate notices and source offer.
